html: Sleep is when the body and brain recover. Most adults do best with seven or more hours a night, and small daily habits make a big difference in how rested you feel.

image.alt: Illustration of a crescent moon over a calm bedroom window
image.caption: Many people sleep best in a room that's cool, dark and quiet.
image.title: Illustration of a crescent moon over a calm bedroom window

html:
• Go to bed and get up around the same times every day
  • Save coffee, tea and energy drinks for the morning
  • Dim the lights and set your phone aside for the last half hour
  • Keep the bed for sleep, not work or scrolling
Mention it at your next visit if you snore loudly, wake up gasping, or feel sleepy during the day even after a full night in bed.

title: Better sleep habits
abstract: Small daily habits that help you fall asleep and wake up rested.
